name: Extra Block Types (EBT): Hero
description: Adds a Hero section block type (title, subtitle/prefix, body, media image, two buttons) with two-column and one-column layouts, optional background overlay and a mobile breakpoint.
project_description: Extra Block Types (EBT): Hero adds a reusable Hero block type to Drupal. Editors get a block with a title, title-prefix/subtitle, body text, a media image, and two call-to-action buttons, arranged either as two columns (image + text) or as a single column. It ships a dedicated field widget (ebt_settings_hero) that extends EBT Basic Button's settings widget with hero-specific options: layout style, image position (left/right and mobile ordering), a mobile breakpoint, and an optional colored overlay over the background. A per-block CSS generator service turns those settings into an inline <style> block. Part of the Extra Block Types family, it is designed for placement in Layout Builder and relies on EBT Core for shared design options (CSS box, background, container width) and on a Media 'image' type for the column image.
